_comment: Template for npm run deploy:mainnet -- --params <this file>. Copy it, fill every field, and keep the filled copy out of git. Nothing here has a default: each value is a production decision the deploy script refuses to make for you. Addresses live in config/base-mainnet.json, not here.
_dickbuttDeployBlock: Block DICKBUTT was created. The calculator scans Transfer events from here and treats what it finds as the complete history. Verified on-chain: the script checks there is no code at block-1 and code at this block, so it needs an archive RPC.
_holderThresholdRaw: Minimum DICKBUTT held to qualify for rewards, in wei. Documented as 6,900,000 DICKBUTT = 6900000000000000000000000.
_payoutThresholdRaw: Minimum SPCXc a recipient must earn to be included in a round, in raw units (8 decimals).
_minPayoutRaw: Calculator guidance stored in DickbuttRewardsDistributor, in SPCXc raw units. The calculator uses the larger of this and payoutThresholdRaw; committed payouts are paid exactly on-chain without a minimum filter.
_batchSize: Recipients per distributeBatch call. In the 3,000-holder native fork, 200 recipients had a conservative 13,552,027 gas envelope; 256 had 17,335,237, above Base's 16,777,216 transaction cap. Estimate exact production calldata/state before choosing. No default.
_chunkSize: Event scan window in blocks. Sized to what the production RPC will serve without rejecting the range; Sepolia used 2000.
_curve: linear or sqrt. Square-root allocation is Sybilable. This is an economics decision.
_maxSwapPerCallWei: SpcxcSwapExecutor cap per swap, in WETH wei. Bounds how much a compromised keeper can push through the pool in one call.
_floorLowerBoundRaw: SPCXc per WETH below which swaps should halt rather than execute, in SPCXc raw units. The floor setter bot can never set a floor under this. Must be nonzero: the executor refuses to approve a floor setter while the bound is zero.
_lockerMinIntervalSeconds: Anti-spam gap between permissionless Clanker locker harvests. Not a security control. Contract maximum is 30 days.
_aerodromeMinIntervalSeconds: Anti-spam gap between permissionless Aerodrome harvests. Contract maximum is 30 days.
_aerodromeUnlockTime: Unix timestamp before which AerodromeFeeHarvester will not release the LP NFT. Constructor requires it in the future and within 100 years. Review this against the locker/legacy permanence discussion in AUDITOR-BRIEF.md before choosing.
